$comment: Per-repo worker-class overlay for Matou/matou-app (dev-factory#29). Merged BY ID onto the vendored tui/worker-classes.json table (the harness's own classes, which deliberately declare no hosts): a known id has its fields overridden — declaring `hosts` leaves the vendored description intact — and a new id is appended. Read by the factory TUI's Fleet screen (tui/data/worker_classes.py). Two hosts carry this repo: `matou-workstation` (= matou-dev-server-01, the automation host that also runs the live e2e/smoke stack) and `elitebook-03` (a lighter pool box); both wear the `swarm` runner-pool label. Classes whose workflow is `runs-on: swarm` run on both; the e2e/drive classes pin to matou-workstation, which is where the KERI/any-sync/backend stack stands up.

classes.name: check-verifications
classes.lock: shared /tmp/matou-swarm.lock (flock -n 9, skips the tick if a triage/swarm run holds it)
classes.writes: the human verification gate: label swaps awaiting-verification -> ready-for-agent (approve) or -> wontfix + closed (reject) resolved by name; issue comments (approval guidance / copied chatter); Mattermost thread confirmations that embed each processed reply id so a rerun never re-acts on the same reply; a re-posted thread when one is missing
classes.stuck_signal: verify.yml's failure() step routes into the healer; a missing verification thread is re-posted rather than stalling the issue; otherwise thin — the poller exits 0 quietly when chat env is unset
classes.invisible_failure_note: the one worker class the vendored table describes only secondhand (it is not shipped by the factory); its failures are gate-visible via the healer hook, unlike the reporter/session-runner exit-0 classes
